findings.current: Im Kkeokjeong was waiting to load his bags into the bus’s trunk. He grinned wide.
findings.defect: The English specifies multiple bags, while the source only refers to his luggage and the previously established equipment is contained in one large bag.
findings.rationale: The source uses the quantity-neutral 짐, and line 163 previously identifies a single large bag containing his armor and weapons. “His bags” introduces unsupported plurality.
findings.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong was waiting to load his luggage into the bus’s trunk. He grinned wide.

findings.current: “Tall young fellow. Looks like he can fight.”
findings.defect: Rendering 훤칠하네 as merely “tall” omits the favorable impression that he is also fine-looking or handsome.
findings.rationale: 훤칠하다 describes an attractively tall, well-proportioned appearance, not height alone; this is part of the older Hunter’s first physical assessment of Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “Tall, handsome young fellow. Looks like he can fight.”

findings.defect: The assembled line changes a completed arrival into an imminent one.
findings.rationale: 이제 다 도착했으니까요 states that they have now arrived. The approaching Gate can still be drawing nearer within the destination area, but the source does not say that they remain short of arrival. The accepted baseline preserved this distinction.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, but three minor details alter the source’s physical description, quantity, or arrival state.
